hud.event-card.lord-moment.data: the lord's suit filed: its Wave 40 picture and the ledger's sentence

hud.event-card.family-moment.data: the first child: the ledger's sentence, the child and the parents named, the way to the chronicle

modal.history.family-links.data: the first child's record in the chronicle (as modal.history.records: the detail scrolls): a biography button for each person its record names

hud.event-card.famine-answered.data: chapter 1's famine after the answer: the line, until when, the bottleneck left

hud.event-card.will-kept.data: the father's new will as its chip's card: the engine's deadline as a season, the button to the lord screen's marriage page

modal.lord.will-change.data: the father's new will: favour (shut when the treasury is short), support promised (its promise, stake and witnesses), let it stand (the rival's claim) — the engine's run

hud.event-card.suit-defence.data: a neighbour house's suit against the lord: its filing, its stage and next season, the button to the suit in the ledger

hud.event-card.entry-threat.data: a house's forcible entry forewarned: the engine's warning, the season it comes, the button to the warning in the ledger

hud.event-card.audit-kept.data: an audit's finding as its chip's card: what it found, the engine's deadline as a season, the button to the card

hud.event-card.offmap-kept.data: an off-map estate's petition as its chip's card: the ask, the engine's deadline as a season, why it came to the lord, the button to the card

hud.event-chips.market.data: four years after the proclamation, the rail's chips: a house's suit against the lord, the lord's moment, the last decision's trace

hud.event-card.suit-defence.market.data: four years after the proclamation, a house's suit against the lord as its chip's card: its filing, its stage and next season, the button to the ledger

hud.event-card.lord-moment.market.data: four years after the proclamation, the lord's latest moment as its chip's card: the ledger's sentence

hud.event-card.famine.market.data: a season after the proclamation, the great famine's chip (1315–17, the bot's answer given) as its card: its line, until when

hud.event-card.trace.data: the season's news of the lord's decision (the suit filed on the first tick): its year and subject, the neighbour's mind, the way to the chronicle

modal.history.thread-decision.data: the suit filed in 1300, opened from its later chip: what followed (its turns) and who remembers it

modal.lord.home-petition.variant-041.data: the pannage petition on the woodland in autumn in 041's words (the longest variant body)

modal.lord.home-petition.variant-048.data: the common-pasture petition in 048's words (the commons against the second merchant house)

modal.lord.home-petition.variant-056.data: the road and bridge petition beside the market in 056's words

modal.lord.registry.variant-067.data: 031's steward offer in 067's words (ability against loyalty; the longest variant title)

modal.lord.registry.variant-078.data: 019's oversight offer in 078's words (the merchant's man against the peasants')

hud.event-card.home-petition-variant.data: the pannage petition's chip card in 041's words, its card put off

hud.event-card.registry-variant.data: 031's offer's chip card in 067's words, its card put off
